# Barttery 1.2.3
- Fixes Logitech charging-only responses and keeps the lightning indicator visible for a fully charged device reporting its full-on-charger status, including at 100%. - Improves Apple Watch charger-transition monitoring without trusting stale registry flags or expiring state during an uninterrupted live event stream. - Fixes accessory notifications and preserves battery measurement timestamps. - Includes device-helper packaging fixes, the desktop widget, and Sparkle in-app updates.
**Logitech charging detection requires Input Monitoring permission for Barttery:** System Settings → Privacy & Security → Input Monitoring. Restart Barttery after changing permission.
Users of 1.2.0 and earlier must update manually or through Homebrew.

# Barttery 1.2.1
- Adds Sparkle in-app updates. When an update is found, **Update Available…** appears below **Launch at Login**. Click it to review and install the update. - Adds a Liquid Glass application icon for macOS 26 and later, with a static fallback for older macOS versions. - Includes the desktop battery widget and existing Logitech battery monitoring improvements.
Version 1.2.0 users must install this release manually or through Homebrew to enable future in-app updates.
